cr_data.provenance: The Dole Pineapple Company, New York, NY, by commission, 1940; (Doris Bry, New York, NY); Bill Dean, New York, NY, 1980; ACA Galleries, New York, NY, 1980; (John Berggruen Gallery, San Francisco, California); Christie's, New York, NY, sale no. 5906, lot no. 314, 31 May 1985, no sale (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Sold to Hawaiian Pineapple Co. painted 1939." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, 1940 New York (An American Place–O'Keeffe) exhibition checklist.
titles.title: Pineapple Bud

description: Large green leaves extend outward from a textured red and green bud at the center of a pineapple plant. Between the leaves, an orangish brown background is visible.
